+from textfsm import TextFSM
+import io
+
+def test_required_empty():
+    tplt = 'Value Required boo (one)\nValue Filldown hoo (two)\n\nStart\n  ^$boo -> Next.Record\n  ^$hoo -> Next.Record\n\nEOF\n'
+    t = TextFSM(io.StringIO(tplt))
+    data = 'two\n'  # No value for 'boo'
+    result = t.ParseText(data)
+    print(f"Result: {result}")
+    assert result == [], f"Expected empty list, got {result}"
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    try:
+        test_required_empty()
+        print("Test passed!")
+    except Exception as e:
+        print(f"Test failed: {e}")
